news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹17.13 (up from ₹16.69 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹467.3b (up 2.1% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹159.3b (up 2.6% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 34% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 2.2%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 19%. Revenue is forecast to grow 5.9% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Electric Utilities industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has remained flat but the company’s share price has increased by 20% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Dividend of ₹3.25 announced
news.body: Dividend of ₹3.25 is the same as last year. Ex-date: 9th February 2026 Payment date: 27th February 2026 Dividend yield will be 3.1%, which is higher than the industry average of 2.7%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (54% earnings payout ratio) but not covered by cash flows (197% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 23% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 17% over the next 2 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS in line with analyst expectations despite revenue beat
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.50 (up from ₹4.15 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹126.0b (up 12% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹41.8b (up 8.4% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 33% (down from 34% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 5.9%. Earnings per share (EPS) were mostly in line with analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 3.8% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 9.9% growth forecast for the Electric Utilities industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has remained flat but the company’s share price has increased by 17% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
